datasets_evaluated.evidence: Comprehensive experiments are conducted on the IEEE P2668-MLIDD and Bot-IoT datasets, augmented by incorporating cryptographic processing overhead to imitate encrypted network conditions.

label_source.evidence: In this dataset, the DDoS attack subset exhibits class imbalance across attack vectors, which requires class-wise undersampling before it can be used to form balanced training and testing partitions

label_feature_overlap.evidence: The proposed framework utilizes packet interarrival times (PIATs) as its sole observable, enabling not only the detection of attack traffic but also the identification of attack vectors

features_used.evidence: The proposed framework utilizes packet interarrival times (PIATs) as its sole observable

feature_groups.evidence: Discrete wavelet transforms (DWTs) are applied to PIAT sequences to capture both transient and persistent timing patterns across multiple scales.

model_family.evidence: a spatio–temporal hybrid DL model integrating convolutional neural networks (CNN) and attention-enhanced bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM-ATT).

split_protocols.evidence: The dataset is prepartitioned into training and testing subsets. For independent cross-dataset validation, we further utilize the widely recognized Bot-IoT dataset

easy_vs_hard_reported.evidence: In contrast, under cross-dataset validation, where the model is trained exclusively on IEEE P2668-MLIDD and evaluated on Bot-IoT, the accuracy drops substantially to near-chance levels.

shortcut_check.evidence: This method is meticulously crafted to facilitate robust time–frequency feature extraction and to mitigate extended periods of nonresponsiveness (deadlocks) during the traffic capturing phase

metrics.evidence: To assess the classification performance across the aforementioned test subsets, we employ four standard evaluation metrics: overall accuracy, macro-averaged precision, macro-averaged recall, and macro-averaged F1-score.

granularity.evidence: The AVI system captures and monitors network traffic from multiple IP addresses, extracting relevant features to enable the identification and quantification of DDoS attack vectors.
